reference.title: Full Settings Reference
reference.shortdesc: Every settings category in OBS Studio and what it controls.

section.title: General
section.p: Theme, language, confirmation prompts on exit, and system tray behavior.

section.title: Stream
section.p: Streaming service selection, ingest server, and stream key.

section.title: Output
section.p: Encoder selection, bitrate, recording format and path, and replay buffer length. Available in Simple or Advanced mode.

section.title: Audio
section.p: Sample rate, channel layout, and up to four global audio devices in addition to per-source audio.

section.title: Video
section.p: Base (canvas) and output (scaled) resolution, downscale filter, and common and integer FPS values.

section.title: Hotkeys
section.p: Global keyboard shortcuts for scene switching, recording, streaming, muting, and more. See Hotkeys for the default bindings.

section.title: Advanced
section.p: Process priority, color format and space, network buffering, and automatic recovery settings for dropped frames.
